purpose: Teach: 微分/散らし/弁明/欺瞞/排泄/捕鯨/抗争/殺戮

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、薬物動態の微分解析を医療チームで学習しております
lines.en: Ren, your medical team has been studying pharmacokinetic differential analysis.
lines.style: Clear, factual delivery. Steady pace. Warm but professional — the tone of someone explaining her work to an attentive student. No condescension.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、注意喚起のチラシを散らした地域活動を医療チームで支援しました
lines.en: Yes, we supported community outreach that distributed educational flyers about medication awareness.
lines.style: Measured, straightforward. Each phrase carries equal weight. Slight pause before the main clause — she's being precise about what 'support' meant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療過誤の弁明よりも改善を、貴院、優先されてるそうですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital prioritizes improvement over defending against malpractice claims. That's remarkable, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuinely curious, slightly awed. Lean forward quality to the voice. He's testing whether he heard that right, not doubting her. Respectful distance maintained.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療広告の欺瞞表現を医療チームで批判しております
lines.en: Yes, we actively critique deceptive language in medical advertising within our team.
lines.style: Steady, measured. No defensiveness — this is routine for her. Direct eye-contact level of tone. The clinical precision of someone used to speaking about difficult things clearly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 排泄機能障害の患者ケアを、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: I gather your hospital provides care for patients with excretory dysfunction, Doctor?
lines.style: Careful, genuinely interested. He's building understanding, not testing. Slight question-mark lilt at the end. Deferential but not obsequious.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、捕鯨地域の食文化と病気の関連も医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Yes, we also research the connections between regional food culture and disease — including in whaling communities.
lines.style: Factual, unhurried. She's stating her work plainly. A slight weight to it — this is meaningful research, not performative. Steady gaze throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 組織抗争の被害者救命を、貴院、ご経験されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital has actually experienced rescuing victims of organized violence. That's sobering.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. He's processing something difficult she's just implied. Respectful pause quality. No shock in the voice, just genuine acknowledgment of the weight.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、大量殺戮現場での救護も医療チームで備えております
lines.en: Yes, we prepare our medical teams for emergency response in mass casualty situations.
lines.style: Clinical, unflinching. She says this like someone who has thought about it carefully and often. Steady delivery, no quickening. The composure of someone who carries difficult preparedness.
